body:
The RTX attention prototype in #59 matches the original reference, but its all-role/all-phase scope leaves open which constraints are needed and whether relaxing them improves decoding. This PR freezes a coordinated scope → unused-task → length/width → persistent-execution protocol and reports the completed first tranche against manuscript main e87291d and #59 head b0dfa0f.

The complete 16-mask factorial passes only masks 3, 7, 11 and 15 on the four original cases; the sole inclusion-minimal mask in this finite panel enables target prefill and continuation. Mask 3, mask 15 and the matched target-only control qualify all 19 exposed tasks. A separate six-repetition cyclic cost panel preserves 342/342 full reference ID/endpoints. Removing draft constraints gives 1.003569× generation and 1.025686× whole-request ratios versus all-on: it misses the predeclared 1.03× generation gate. Both speculative modes still achieve approximately 1.27× generation speedup against their matched target-only control. The result is scope sufficiency plus measured request savings, with no claim of reliable additional decode acceleration.

Validation:
- Private CLI/server build; 8 old/new all-on complete CLI checks and 8 selective capture-enabled resident checks verify real role/phase graph topology, request reset and graph-reuse eligibility.
- A1: 128 measured checks; A2: 114 qualification requests; A3: 342 cost requests. Together with engineering and 60 excluded warmups: 660 complete generation requests. All 32 A1 non-reference outputs are retained.
- Post-audit checks all 3,547 Phase 1 and 3,548 Phase 2 source files, original programs, models and 33 published runtime DLLs; no original assets changed. One zero-model build preparation failure is retained.
- Local content-addressed raw archive: 55,324,500 bytes, SHA256 cd57ec99359b35ce201cf7c1b19979a46e05af3d03740e3cc2a753d596ca2b3d; CRC and every object SHA256 verified. Frozen isolated Git history and all raw runs/source/private executables are included; the immutable #59 archive remains a separate dependency.
- All 42 uploaded files were read back and matched their Git blob SHA1. The diff only adds benchmarks/rtx_consistency_phase2/.

B/C/D are designed but unexecuted; their exposure/configuration manifests must be frozen before model runs. All 19 current tasks are exposed, not a holdout. No global-minimality, universal invariance, functional code-accuracy, actual CUDA-kernel-dispatch, or unmeasured platform/throughput claim is made. Raw telemetry, model weights and runtime DLLs stay local; the manuscript and existing PRs are unchanged.
title: RTX Phase 2: target-only consistency scope and gated expansion
